purpose: stage the theme as the choice of a single word
end before the verdict, comfort withheld
entry_state: Mira knows what Radan did and that a faithful, innocent rendering acquits
desire: do right — and she cannot tell which rendering that is
conflict: render the damning sense (become Josif's blade, convict on a truth the law should not reach) or the innocent sense (free a guilty man, impose her own mercy) — either way she is not neutral
turn: the decisive question is put to Josif; he gives the double word; Mira renders the single sense into the record, and it cannot be taken back
exit_state: the reader cannot cleanly call it justice or its opposite
forbidden_moves: Mira's speech about truth versus law
style_constraints: pull the distance to the word itself at the turn
end on the act, not the reflection
candidate_strategies: A: the reader sees which sense she renders only through its cost
B: the word given in the dialect, its chosen sense left for the reader to weigh
